project.name: MCP Search :: Eval
project.description:
Search quality evaluation: IR metrics (precision@k, recall@k, MRR, NDCG@k) and a runner that executes a golden set of judged queries against any search function.
Depends on nothing - the search function is injected as query -> ranked ids - so the harness is unit-testable with stubs and can equally drive a real adapter in an integration test, or A/B two configurations against the same golden set.
